system.description: You may expend a lore point to toss an enemy that is within one size of you (e.g., Small, Medium, or Large if you are a Medium Creature). You throw the enemy a number of tiles equal to your Finesse + Power score (+2 if they are a size smaller than you, -1 if they are a size larger than you). They take thrown damage when they land. As they are tossed, they can provoke attacks of opportunity from allies whose melee range the target leaves.
